pages.title: Attoscale Capacitor
pages.text: A capacitor that stores charge in the Higgs field itself rather than in the electric field between plates. It is a thousand times smaller than its femtoscale ancestor. The energy it holds changes the mass of anything nearby very slightly.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Femto Fabricator I wired a Femtoscale Capacitor to a Higgs Field Capacitor using Exotic Solder. The charge moved off the plates and into the Higgs field, shrinking the capacitor a thousandfold.
